Introducing agent mode in ChatGPT

November 4, 2026 OpenAI

Agent mode lets ChatGPT plan and carry out multi-step tasks using the tools you already work with, while keeping you in control of every action.

How agent mode works

The model breaks a request into steps, calls the tools it needs and reports back with the result. You can stop the run at any point.

Availability

Agent mode starts rolling out today to Pro, Team and Enterprise users on web and desktop.
